Total bar numbers are exact — they ship straight from the API receipt. Per-piece rows are heuristic — each piece's cost is its share of billedInput times totalInputCost.
The five system.* sub-artifacts roll into one System prompt row in the UI; hover reveals the breakdown. Striped portion of any bar marks the cached prefix.
